consequence.statement: The ValidateCAA feature gate still functions in cert-manager v1.17 but is deprecated and will be removed entirely in cert-manager v1.18.0, so environments relying on it for CAA DNS record validation during ACME issuance will lose that behaviour when they upgrade to v1.18.0.
consequence.remediation: Remove ValidateCAA from feature-gate configuration (--feature-gates / chart featureGates) and stop relying on CAA record validation during ACME issuance before upgrading to cert-manager v1.18.0.

assertion.statement: cert-manager v1.17 deprecates the ValidateCAA feature gate, which validates the CAA DNS record during ACME issuance; it still works in v1.17 but will be removed entirely in cert-manager v1.18.0.
